test_objective: Check that you can query context source registrations. If present, the conditions specified by the context source query match the respective Context Source Properties

test_cases.name: 037_10_01 With list of Entity Ids
test_cases.doc: Check that you can query context source registrations. If present, the conditions specified by the context source query match the respective Context Source Properties
test_cases.template: Query Context Source Registration With Query Params
test_cases.when:
when {
    the SUT receives a Request from the client containing:
        URL set to '/ngsi-ld/v1/csourceRegistrations'
        method set to 'GET'
        Retrieve Temporal Representation of Entity and
    Query Parameter: context set to 'https://forge.etsi.org/rep/cim/ngsi-ld-test-suite/-/raw/develop/resources/jsonld-contexts/ngsi-ld-test-suite-compound.jsonld' and
    Query Parameter: id set to '${first_context_source_registration_id},${third_context_source_registration_id}'
}
